what: Proposed SquadMembers.DeathPriority for every China infantry unit, following the vanilla US/RU pattern. Higher value dies first.
mechanism: InfantryDeathHealSystem.KillSquadSolders 0x40CFF0 (1.2.2.1): kills an alive soldier with the highest DeathPriority; random among equals. HealSquad 0x40BE90 revives the first dead soldier with the lowest value.
data_source: vanilla rows (lateralus-infantry-20261110/vanilla) + dev-wt releases/0.6/source/UserData/FreedomArrow/constants (657d31e1); squad_members.json identical to 091-wt
rule: A (value 1): one keeper = best member by ATGM > RPG reloadable > MANPADS > sniper/AMR > HMG/AGL crew > rifle + disposable AT > rifle + grenade > MG > stand-alone GL > marksman > shotgun > rifle + UBGL > rifle only; equal members -> lowest SquadMembers Id
B: other specialists (ATGM, RPG reloadable, MANPADS, sniper/AMR, HMG/AGL), MG, marksman, shotgun, stand-alone GL, flashbang carrier
C: rifle + under-barrel GL, rifle + disposable AT
values = dense rank of the tiers present in the squad (A=1, next present tier 2, ...); equal values die in random order, as in vanilla
